messages:
rui: Heads up — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123. Addressed comments from yesterday re: telemetry encoding and the cache invalidation path. PTAL when you have a minute; need 2 approvals for a hotfix merge before 16:00 UTC. Summary: fixed encode/decode edge-case, added unit test, small perf tweak.

maya: on it, pinging while I run tests

maya: left one comment about naming in telemetry.go — small rename please (tTelemetry -> tkr) and maybe add a short comment

rui: good catch, updated and pushed: commit 3b2f9d7. command: ```git commit -am 'telemetry: rename tTelemetry -> tkr + comment' && git push origin fix/telemetry-enc```

priya: @rui can you avoid force-push? we prefer a new commit so CI history stays clean

rui: sure — pushed as new commit instead. thanks @maya for the catch. CI green ✅

andrew: verifying on staging now. quick perf smoke: latency unchanged, memory slightly down :thumbsup:

maya: LGTM, approving now

andrew: approved. @ops-deploy-bot can we schedule merge/patch? (target before 16:00 UTC)

ops-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled a patch-merge window at 15:50 UTC. I'll merge once last approval is present.

rui: thanks everyone, merging after one more approval. will watch post-merge logs for 30m.
